guidance: Center the report's needs. Capture blockers and support asks clearly. Action items must be owned. Keep notes concise. Do not invent personal details or performance judgments.

outline.title: Check-In
outline.guidance: Pulse on the report's current state.

children.title: Current Mood
children.guidance: Short pulse on energy, workload, or burnout risk—in the report's words when possible.

children.title: Top of Mind
children.guidance: Most pressing topic the report wants to discuss.

children.title: Agenda Item
children.guidance: Title each instance with the topic, not "Agenda Item".

outline.title: Roadblocks & Support
outline.guidance: Blockers the manager can help with. Wrapper is always present; omit blockers when none.

children.title: Blocker
children.guidance: Title each instance with the blocker name.

children.title: The Issue
children.guidance: What is slowing the report down.

children.title: How I Can Help
children.guidance: What the manager will do to unblock.

outline.title: Action Items
outline.guidance: Owned follow-ups before the next sync.

children.title: Task
children.guidance: Title each instance with the next step, not "Task".

children.title: Next Steps
children.guidance: What happens before the next sync.
